exerciseVideos.title: 10-Min Night Shift Wake-Up Stretch
exerciseVideos.description: A gentle full-body stretch to ease stiffness after a night shift without spiking cortisol.
instructions: Start standing with feet hip-width apart, roll your shoulders back 5 times
Reach both arms overhead and side-bend gently to each side
Fold forward slowly, letting your head hang for 3 deep breaths
Step into a low lunge, holding 30 seconds each side
Finish with slow neck circles in both directions

exerciseVideos.title: 20-Min No-Equipment HIIT
exerciseVideos.description: A quick cardio burst to boost alertness before a shift. No gear needed.
instructions: Warm up: 2 minutes of marching on the spot
30 seconds jumping jacks, 15 seconds rest
30 seconds high knees, 15 seconds rest
30 seconds bodyweight squats, 15 seconds rest
Repeat the circuit 4 times, then cool down with light stretching

exerciseVideos.title: 25-Min Wind-Down Yoga
exerciseVideos.description: A calming yoga flow designed to prepare your body for sleep after a long shift.
instructions: Begin seated, 5 slow breaths with eyes closed
Move through cat-cow for 1 minute
Hold downward dog for 30 seconds
Transition to pigeon pose, 1 minute each side
Finish in legs-up-the-wall for 5 minutes

exerciseVideos.title: 5-Min Reset Meditation
exerciseVideos.description: A short guided breathing meditation to reset your nervous system mid-shift.
instructions: Sit comfortably with your back supported
Breathe in for 4 counts, hold for 4, out for 6
Repeat this cycle for 3 minutes
Finish by noticing 3 sounds around you

nutritionVideos.title: 5-Min Overnight Oats
nutritionVideos.description: A no-cook breakfast you prep the night before — ready when you wake.
instructions: Add 1/2 cup oats to a jar
Pour in 1/2 cup milk of choice and 1 tbsp chia seeds
Stir in a spoon of yoghurt and a drizzle of honey
Top with berries, seal, and refrigerate overnight

nutritionVideos.title: 15-Min Anti-Inflammatory Bowl
nutritionVideos.description: A nutrient-dense lunch bowl that fights the inflammation linked to shift work.
instructions: Cook 1/2 cup quinoa per packet instructions
Roast chickpeas with turmeric and olive oil for 10 minutes
Chop spinach, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes
Combine and dress with lemon and tahini

nutritionVideos.title: 20-Min One-Pan Salmon
nutritionVideos.description: An omega-3 rich dinner that supports brain health on irregular schedules.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C
Place salmon fillet and chopped vegetables on a lined tray
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper
Bake 15–18 minutes until salmon flakes easily

nutritionVideos.title: 30-Min Batch Snack Prep
nutritionVideos.description: Prep a week of grab-and-go snacks so you never rely on vending machines.
instructions: Portion mixed nuts into 7 small containers
Boil 6 eggs and store in the fridge
Slice veggies and pair with hummus cups
Roll oat-and-date energy balls and refrigerate
